items.summary: After more than 10 years of waiting, Rockstar's GTA 6 is finally available now (at least in New Zealand and Australia ). items.summary: Goat Simulator and Satisfactory outfit Coffee Stain Group have bought the intellectual property rights and assets for Chronicles: Medieval, the Tom Hardy-garnished strategy RPG that was originally in development at now-bankrupt Raw Power Games.
